newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Keene, N.H.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Keene, N.H.

text.p: The City of Keene, New Hampshire will receive proposals until 11:00 A.M. (E.S.T.) Tuesday, for the purchase of the following described Bonds of the City. Bonds will be dated October 15, 1996. The first Principal payment will be due October 15, 1998, and annually thereafter. Interest will be due semi-annually on October 15 and April 15, commencing October 15, 1997. Bonds will be issued in fully registered form by means of book-entry system in $5,000 denominations or any integral multiple thereof. Principal and interest will be payable at Citizens Bank New Hampshire, Manchester, NH, Paying Agent.

Bonds are offered for delivery, when, as and if issued, subject to final approving opinion of Devine, Millimet & Branch, P.A., Manchester, NH. Delivery of the Bonds in definitive form will be made on or about October 15, 1996. Additional information concerning the City of Keene Bonds is contained in the Official Statement dated September 24, 1996. Copies may be obtained from Jan Snyder, Citizens Bank New Hampshire, Financial Advisor, 875 Elm Street,
